svg.text: P&ID BOILER FEEDWATER SYSTEM (DEAERATOR → ECONOMIZER INLET) — PLTU 1×300 MW, SUBCRITICAL DRUM BOILER
ZONA B — BOOSTER / BOILER FEED PUMPS (3×50 %)
24"-FW-101 SUCTION HEADER (FW 165 °C, ~10 barg incl. static head ≥ 20 m NPSHa)
(dari header via RO-140, ke suction pompa standby)
8"-FW-109 MIN-FLOW RECIRC RETURN → V-101B (ke storage tank, spray nozzle bawah)
16"-FW-130 HP HEATER GROUP BYPASS (MOV-130 normally closed, opens on I-3)
Huruf ISA-5.1: pertama = variabel (P,T,L,F,A,V,Z,S) • berikutnya = fungsi (T transmitter, I indicator, C controller, V valve, S switch, LL/HH trip)
C1 Drum level 3-element: LIC-117 (level) + FT-118 (steam, feedforward) + FT-116 (FW, feedback) → FIC-116 → FCV-116. Beban < 30 %: otomatis 1-element via FCV-119 (bumpless, berdasarkan FT-118).
C2 Kecepatan BFP: PDIC-110 menjaga ΔP header–drum (PT-110 − PT-117) ≈ 10 bar → SC-110 A/B/C; pompa standby speed-follow.
C3 Min-flow: FIC-109x membuka FV-109x penuh bila FT-109x < 25 % BEP, menutup bila > 35 % (histeresis anti-chatter). FV fail-open.
C4 Deaerator: PIC-101 → PV-101 (pegging, SP 7 barg); LIC-101 → LV-101 (kondensat), split-range ke LV-101B overflow saat LAH.
C5 HP heater: LIC-114/115 → LV-114A/115A drain normal (cascade); LAH → LV-114B/115B emergency drain ke kondensor.
I-1 LSLL-101 deaerator (< 15 %) → trip semua BFP; PSLL-102x suction < 4 barg (3 s) → trip BFP x.
I-2 Proteksi mesin BFP x: PSLL-106 lube oil, TSHH-104 bearing > 90 °C, VSHH-105 > 11 mm/s, FSLL-109 < 20 % & FV-109 tidak ZSO dalam 10 s, TSHH-107 winding → trip motor.
I-3 LSHH-114/115 shell HP heater (tube leak) → tutup XV-106/107 ekstraksi, buka MOV-130, tutup MOV-131 & MOV-132 (< 10 s), buka LV-B emergency drain.

I-4 Trip pompa running atau PAL PT-110 < 175 barg → auto-start BFP standby (permissive: MOV-101 ZSO, MOV-108 ZSC, FV-109 ZSO, PSH-106 lube OK, ΔT casing < 40 °C, LT-101 > LAL); MOV-108 dibuka setelah speed ≥ min.
I-5 LSLL-117 / LSHH-117 drum (2oo3) → Master Fuel Trip; FCV-116/119 hold posisi. Turbine trip → FIC-116 ke SP minimum, PDIC-110 manual-hold.

CATATAN UMUM: 1) Tag per ISA-5.1, nomor loop seri 100 = BFW. 2) Ukuran pipa estimasi (v ≤ 1.5 m/s suction, ≤ 4.5 m/s discharge); material A335 P11 kelas 1500# untuk > 100 barg. 3) Semua MOV dilengkapi ZSO/ZSC. 4) Vent, drain, sampling & injeksi kimia (N2H4/NH3 di suction header) tidak digambar. 5) Rev.A – untuk review, bukan untuk
